newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Polar to sell only part of Provincial stake - report.
newsitem.headline: Polar to sell only part of Provincial stake - report.

text.p: Venezuela's Polar said it would sell only a small portion of its 35 percent stake in leading local bank Banco Provincial to Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya SA, leading daily El Nacional reported Tuesday.

Polar Executive Director Lorenzo Mendoza told El Nacional the powerful foods and brewing group did not plan on selling a stake that would give Banco Bilbao control of Provincial, Venezuela's largest bank.
Earlier this month, Banco Bilbao said it was interested in acquiring positions in Banco Provincial as well as in other Venezuelan banks.

French bank Credit Lyonnais has said it was negotiating to sell its 17 percent share of Provincial to Banco Bilbao. The sale would come as part of a wider selloff of Credit Lyonnais' Latin American investments in retail banking.
